This is an awesome quest series.  At level 53 I got around 15,000 experience for just running to Uldum and back.  You go to Uldum, complete a quest, pick up another quest which you complete at the pedestal moments after you pick it up, then take another quest back to IF, where you get another quest to walk 10 feet.  All told, a heck of a lot of experience for very little effort.  I didn't event have to fight a single one of the elite giants in front of Uldum.
